source.authoredBasis: Authored plane-set candidates conditional on visible floor definition: A shades [0,1) times R, B shades R times [1,2), C shades [1,2) times [2,3), D shades the diagonal unit tiles [n,n+1) times [n,n+1), n integer. Solid edges are included; dashed edges excluded; filled/open corner dots resolve corner membership. Shading reaches the plot-window edge for unbounded sets; viewport borders are not set boundaries. All n tiles repeat beyond the view. No source image exists; inventory is conceptual, not pixel provenance.

notes: All four shaded panels A-D and bottommost negative tile visible. A: vertical strip with solid x=0 and dashed x=1. B: horizontal strip with solid y=1 and dashed y=2. C: rectangle x=1..2,y=2..3 with included lower-left, three open other corners. D: five diagonal unit tiles for n=-2..2 with solid left/bottom, dashed top/right, filled diagonal lattice points and open mixed corners; terminal (3,3) is filled as the next tile's point. Each polygon, edge and corner coordinate was compared to the independently interpreted floor sets. C's four relative displacements and D's 16 visible point relations remain inside their respective inventory groups. Shading in A/B reaches the frame edge rather than inventing restrictions on the free coordinate. D repetition is labeled; all diagonal integer points are included in the union even though top/right edges of each preceding square are excluded. Full image actually viewed once; visible labels are English/numerical, no cultural marks, solutions or correct-option annotations. Neutral semantic SVG colors and clear strokes. Scratch-path packaging is pending the parent, not a second mathematical gate.
